'''Tom Potter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2002 Wenatchee tournament]] on 30 March 2002 with LSCing Gungans, according to Earl Sessions's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3557">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-04-wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-warsd3557/ wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-wars], DeckTech (Earl "farScape1" Sessions, 4 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-04-wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-warsd3557/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
